title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Acts 10: the vision of Cornelius, Peter's vision on the housetop, and the Holy Spirit poured out in Caesarea.

questions.text: Cornelius was a centurion of what regiment?
questions.explanation: Acts 10:1 calls Cornelius a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment, in Caesarea.

answers.text: The regiment of Caesarea
The Italian Regiment
The temple guard
The regiment of Judea

questions.text: What did the angel tell Cornelius to do?
questions.explanation: The angel told him to send men to Joppa and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

answers.text: To send men to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter
To go up to Jerusalem to worship
To give more gifts to the needy
To gather his relatives and wait

questions.text: What was Peter doing on the housetop at about noon?
questions.explanation: Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon, and he became hungry.

answers.text: Eating a meal
Teaching the brothers
Praying
Waiting for the men from Caesarea

questions.text: What did Peter see coming down to him in the vision?
questions.explanation: He saw heaven opened and a container like a great sheet let down by four corners, holding all kinds of animals, reptiles and birds.

answers.text: A cloud receiving him up into heaven
Tongues like fire on each of them
An angel of God in bright clothing
A great sheet let down with all kinds of animals

questions.text: How did Peter answer the voice that told him to kill and eat?
questions.explanation: Peter said, "Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean."

answers.text: That he was hungry and ready to eat
That he had never eaten anything unclean
That he did not know who was speaking
That he wanted to know what the vision meant

questions.text: What did the voice say to him the second time?
questions.explanation: A voice came to him again the second time, "What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean."

answers.text: "What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean."
"Rise, Peter, kill and eat!"
"Go with them, doubting nothing."
"Stand up! I myself am also a man."

questions.text: What did the Spirit tell Peter while he was pondering the vision?
questions.explanation: The Spirit told him that three men were seeking him, and that he should get down and go with them, doubting nothing.

answers.text: That he should return to Jerusalem
That he should wait on the housetop
That an angel had spoken in Caesarea
That three men sought him and he should go with them

questions.text: What did Peter say when Cornelius fell down at his feet?
questions.explanation: Peter raised him up, saying, "Stand up! I myself am also a man."

answers.text: "Why have you come?"
"Your prayers have gone up before God."
"Stand up! I myself am also a man."
"It is unlawful for me to come to you."

questions.text: What did Peter perceive about God as he began to speak?
questions.explanation: Peter opened his mouth and said that he truly perceived that God does not show favoritism.

answers.text: That God does not show favoritism
That God dwells in no temple
That God had cleansed every food
That God chose Israel only

questions.text: What happened while Peter was still speaking these words?
questions.explanation: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

answers.text: The house where they sat was shaken
An angel stood among them
The Holy Spirit fell on all who heard the word
They all asked to be circumcised
